text:
I fixed the seven bugs I found in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the fixes come from reading the code and tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma` (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). I made up the author, year and copies because the tests only check the title.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days late by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events (an off-by-one fix).
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** the import now points at `catalog.text` instead of the nonexistent `catalog.nonexistent`.

I didn't modify the tests.
